title: RoadWatch roadway segment row
description: One row of the RoadWatch roadway-segment network. A segment is a directed, km-stationed slice of a route centerline that carries a stable segment_uid and resolves to the Puerto Rico baseline grid via Cell_ID (see docs/SPATIAL_OVERLAY_JOIN_RULES.md). All values are carried as strings in staging, matching schemas/infrastructure_projects.schema.json.

source_id.description: Producing source_id from the source registry (e.g. dtop_centerline_lrs).

source_file.description: Path or name of the source artifact the row was derived from.

segment_uid.description: Stable RoadWatch segment unique id. Deterministic; see ID conventions in docs/ROADWATCH_CORRIDOR_MAPPING.md.

route_id.description: Route identifier, e.g. PR-52, US-2, I-3.

route_class.description: Route class token: interstate | us | pr_primary | pr_secondary | pr_tertiary | municipal | unknown.

direction.description: Direction of travel the segment represents: N | S | E | W | NB | SB | EB | WB | both | unknown.

km_start.description: Segment start station in kilometres along the route LRS.

km_end.description: Segment end station in kilometres along the route LRS.

municipality.description: Municipio the segment falls in; many-to-many when a segment crosses a boundary (list the dominant municipio).

Cell_ID.description: Puerto Rico baseline grid Cell_ID the segment resolves to (registry/spatial). Empty until the spatial join is computed.

geometry_ref.description: Reference into the LineString geometry layer (layer_id + feature id, or a geojson path).

crs.description: Coordinate reference system of the source geometry, e.g. EPSG:32161 (NAD83 PR/VI) or EPSG:4326.

raw_text_excerpt.description: Verbatim source snippet supporting the row.

confidence.description: Confidence in [0-1] as a string; see docs/confidence_model.md.
